caveats: Control IDs and titles compiled from public secondary summaries (scytale-labs GRC-Claude-Skills annex-a-ai-controls.md; Mindset Cyber ISO 42001 implementation checklist; genai-security-project crosswalk LLM_ISO42001.md; 6clicks ISO 42001 checklist; Bridewell ISO 42001 guide), all retrieved 2026-09-23. The official ISO/IEC 42001:2023 text is paywalled and was NOT consulted.

Public sources DISAGREE on A.6 sub-numbering (e.g. verification-and-validation appears as A.6.2.4 in one source and A.6.2.6 in another). Where numbering is disputed the control carries id_candidates listing both; verify against the official text before any certification use.
38 controls are expected per ISO; this file enumerates 36 distinct controls with 2 unaccounted (see unaccounted_controls). The file must not be presented as a complete or authoritative control list.

Status values: mapped = implemented in product with tests; partial = product provides mechanisms or evidence but the control is not fully covered; organizational = the control is an organizational process the product can supply evidence for but cannot itself satisfy; gap = not covered.

Module and test citations were verified to exist in the repository tree on 2026-09-23. They prove the mechanism exists and is tested, not that the control is satisfied for any particular deployment or auditor.
